definition: a feeling of craving food or something else
description: A young man in a tie-dye hoodie and a backwards cap sits on a picnic blanket in a sunny park and sinks his teeth into a red apple. He then attacks an enormous stacked cheeseburger taller than his head, sauce all over his chin, and follows it with a huge slice of watermelon. The shot widens: he and his friends are surrounded by a spread of burgers, fried chicken, corn and watermelon, all eating at once.

de.answer: Der Mann mit der Kappe hat einen riesigen Appetit.
de.question: Wer hat einen riesigen Appetit?

es.answer: El hombre de la gorra tiene un apetito enorme.
phrases: darle un mordisco a una manzana
tener el pelo largo y rizado
es.question: ¿Quién tiene un apetito enorme?

fr.answer: L'homme à la casquette a un appétit énorme.
fr.question: Qui a un appétit énorme ?
